snippet.title: SCARLET PRISM - twin-stick arcade phantasmagoria
snippet.description:
SCARLET PRISM is a frenetic, colourful, fast-paced arcade shooter. Eye-melting and senses-burning!

You play as Ciel, an angelic maiden cast into a celestial arena, destined to battle heavenly beings and malignant crystals for all eternity. Survive for as long as you can in this endless gauntlet!

Features:
=Endless arcade carnage, amped to the max!
=Hundreds of bullets - free of charge!
=Overstimulating visuals, just the way we like them.
=3 devastating special weapons, plus an upgrade system for your main gun.
=8 dangerous celestial enemies!
=Scoring system based around your special weapons and cancelling enemy bullets - let them fill the screen with projectiles!
=Head-pounding, blood-pumping, door-kicking electronic music by Cadmium!
=Online scoreboard!
=High refresh rate support!
